description: A Flutter widget screen that displays the device's Firebase Cloud Messaging token, allows copying it to clipboard, and reloading it. It manages token retrieval, error handling, and UI updates.

classes.name: DeviceTokenScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget presenting a screen where the user can view, refresh, and copy the device's Firebase messaging token.

classes.name: _DeviceTokenScreenState
classes.description: The state class for DeviceTokenScreen handling token loading, UI state, and user interactions.

methods.name: _loadToken
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes Firebase messaging, requests permission, retrieves the device token, and handles errors, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: _copyToken
methods.description: Copies the retrieved device token to the system clipboard and shows a snackbar notification.
